environment.description: Ktor microservice deployed on bare EC2 instance (m5.large) behind a Network Load Balancer (NLB) in TCP passthrough mode. No application-layer proxy or rate limiting. Service is directly exposed on port 8080 via target group health checks. CloudWatch metrics collected but no alarms configured. The NLB operates at Layer 4 only and does not inspect HTTP headers or enforce request rate policies. Average response latency is 2-4ms with sub-millisecond jitter due to dedicated CPU pinning via cgroup cpuset.

config.network: VPC with public subnet, security group allows 0.0.0.0/0 on port 8080
